correctness.rationale: The proof constructs the exact symmetric quotient B=uu^T-D, applies rank-one interlacing term by term, uses trace zero and the one-positive-eigenvalue property, and proves equality by an exact -1 eigenspace multiplicity calculation. value.rationale: The result calibrates an actively studied bipartiteness measure on a canonical infinite family, gives a unique extremizer and an exact normalized minimum, and exposes the structural phenomenon that fixed clique number r can coexist with spectral bipartiteness of order 1/N. It is not a finite table, a renaming, or a routine one-case extension.
